paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is 7.4 as of July 24, 2026, with a 17.09% change from the prior close. The price has decreased by 15.91% over a window of 21 sessions. There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.

There have been various SEC filings recently, including the appointment of four new officers, the resignation of director Miles Everson, and the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031.
